headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Paul Wight wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event in a Street Fight match against Golden Jets & Ibushi vs. Fletcher, Hobbs & Takeshita vs. The Golden Jets vs. Chris Jericho vs. Kenny Omega vs. Kota Ibushi vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Brian Cage, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.36 ? a good, competitive contest. In his first match since March 2022, a returning Paul Wight teamed with Jericho, Omega and Ibushi in a street fight, taking out Kyle Fletcher with a WMD punch before Powerhouse Hobbs answered by slamming him through the hood of a car.

On this day in 2025, the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Kyle Fletcher vs. Scorpio Sky went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 6.57. It marked Scorpio Sky's 10th match with the title on the line. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
2024 brought us this moment: Ricochet vs. Dante Martin closed out Rampage, rated 6.57.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2025, back when it was Hyan's first night in AEW against Riho & Windsor & World, appearing on Collision, rated 5.61.
On a Wednesday in 2023, back when AEW welcomed Komander & Penta for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.66 ? a strong outing.
Flash back to 2025, when LFI (Guevara & Rush) went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.03 ? a match that delivered.
